summary: Bundle F frontend E2E tested on the live preview URL as stealth (owner) on demo center 'Stealth Family' (cf5a475c04cd4860976920cda63fa6ff). All 12 report cards render across 5 categories. Opened 'Responsibility & Task Summary' (rc-report-viewer, rc-report-title 'Stealth Family — Responsibility & Task Summary'), 12 summary tiles, 5 breakdown groups with CSS bars; preset 'Last 90 days' + Apply reloads with new date range shown in header ('2026-05-03 → 2026-08-01 (UTC)'). Member Workload opens with rc-report-table (2 rows). Saved view: window.prompt captured via page.on('dialog'), view saved and reopened, then deleted. Exports (CSV, XLSX, PDF) queued via rc-export-csv/xlsx/pdf; polling rc-export-refresh shows all statuses ready within one poll; rc-export-download-{id} triggered a real file download ('work_summary.pdf'). Print: window.print stubbed and fired on rc-report-print, rc-printing class added briefly. Digest Preview at /settings/account → Centers tab: rc-digest-preview-btn → rc-digest-preview-panel appears with rc-digest-preview-label 'Preview — Not Sent'. Birthday panel (rc-birthday-panel) in Settings tab: center toggle works; personal opt-in with month=6/day=15 → rc-birthday-shared-label appears; rc-birthday-optout reverts. Admin analytics at /admin/responsibility-center → rc-admin-tab-reports → rc-admin-reports-tab renders 11 metric cards (centers_created, memberships_activated, renewal_attempts/failures, items_created/completed, events_created, units_created, attendance_enabled_events, report_exports, closure_requests) + 2 breakdowns (by status, by type); rc-admin-reports-range=7 reloads. Permission gating: tftwo is 'member' (verified via GET /api/responsibility-center/{cid} members list). tftwo does NOT see the Reports tab content (catalog denied → tab hidden effectively); API POST /reports/fire_power_activity as tftwo returns 403 as expected. Mobile (390x844): catalog + viewer have no horizontal overflow (scrollW==winW==390), rc-report-table has overflow-x:auto for horizontal scroll, export history usable. Regression: other tabs (overview/work/groups/calendar/members/vault/settings) render fine for both stealth and tftwo.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor testid semantics: The review request calls the Reports tab button 'rc-tab-reports', but in ResponsibilityCenterDashboard.jsx the tab BUTTON has data-testid='rc-dash-tab-reports' and 'rc-tab-reports' is placed on the catalog CONTENT root (RcReportsTab.jsx). Both are present so tests using either pass, but this is inconsistent with other Bundle testid patterns and could confuse future test authors. Consider adding data-testid='rc-tab-reports' to the button element too, or standardize on rc-dash-tab-*.

Non-blocking dev warning still fires ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') from Emergent x-* instrumentation wrapping option text in RcReportsTab member/unit dropdowns and elsewhere. React hydration warning only in dev mode; production build unaffected. Same as noted in iteration_100.

In RcReportsTab.jsx, the 'catalog.denied' fallback renders rc-reports-denied but the parent tab button (rc-dash-tab-reports) is still visible for users who cannot access ANY report — currently that just means clicking it shows the denied message. Consider hiding the Reports tab from the dashboard nav for pure 'member' role users to reduce noise (tftwo saw the Reports tab exist but only shows the 'not available' message).
download() in RcReportsTab.jsx creates a blob URL and clicks a synthetic <a>; if the download button is clicked twice quickly there's no debounce — very minor.

AdminReportsTab metric keys (centers_created, ...) render with the raw key as label via k.replace(/_/g,' '); acceptable but could be humanized (e.g., 'Attendance-enabled events' instead of 'attendance enabled events'). Cosmetic only.
